count_input: tximport countsFromAbundance=no gene-level estimated counts from 189509 exact-shared transcripts

candidate_filters.A: estimated gene count >= 10 in at least 4 of 16 samples
candidate_filters.B: CPM >= 1 in at least 2 of 16 samples
candidate_filters.C: CPM >= 1 in at least 4 of 16 samples

primary_filter_rationale: Library-size-aware, unsupervised minimum expression in at least one quarter of the 16 samples; condition and batch labels are not used to select genes
qc_transformation: log2(library-size CPM + 1) on genes retained by primary filter
sample_correlation: Pearson across filtered genes, descriptive only
pca: samples as observations; genes as features; no condition or batch labels in fitting
outlier_review_rule: Flag estimated gene count total >1.75 times or <1/1.75 times the sample median; flag a sample whose mean correlation to its own condition is more than 0.05 below the condition median; inspect PCA descriptively; do not remove automatically
ev8_status_rule: NO_OBVIOUS_ISSUE if higher estimated count tracks ENA depth, mean within-condition correlation is no more than 0.05 below the condition median, and nearest PCA neighbor distance is at most twice the across-sample median nearest-neighbor distance; otherwise QC_REVIEW_NEEDED unless an independent technical defect is confirmed
